description:
Work with Gmail for the user through the connected Gmail integration: read, search, thread and send mail. The retired local SMTP/IMAP script (`gmail.py`) is gone — the integration is the only route. Can: send email with attachments, read the inbox with Gmail-query search (from:, subject:, is:unread, dates), open a thread, reply in-thread, pull attachments, create a draft, search contacts.
Use this skill when the user asks to: - Send an email / write to someone / write to email - Check mail / see what arrived / is there a reply - Write to someone on my behalf / reply to an email - Attach a file to an email / send with attachment - Get an archive password / request access via email - Any email-related task (send, read, check, monitor inbox)
NOT for: Telegram messaging, SMS, or other non-email communication channels.
